title: Habit tracker
audience: For anyone building a few small daily habits.
description: Tick today's habits, change them and see your streaks. Or tell your AI what you did and it logs the day.
tagline: Tick off a few small habits every day.
seoTitle: Habit tracker template and app for ChatGPT and Claude
note:
Habit tracker

Pick your habits in the app, then tick them off each day. Or tell your AI what you did and it records the day.

## Weekly check-in
Ask your AI how your week went, and its three lines land here.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Habit tracker". It is an app; its data is "Habit tracker.app/data.json", beside the note. Read it with fetch before each change, and change it with edit. If values.started isn't set, its habits are only suggestions: ask which I want, write values.habits as { id, name, target } (target 1, or a count with its unit) and set values.started to today (yyyy-mm-dd). When I tell you what I did: in values.days, under the date, set each habit id to 1, or to its count. Keep the ids. If I skip a day on purpose, add the id to values.skips under the date instead. When I ask for my week, add three short lines under "Weekly check-in" in the note: what went well, what slipped, one thing to try.

asks: Ask which habits I want to track, then set up my tracker.
Which habit did I miss most this month?

args.old_string: Ask your AI how your week went, and its three lines land here.
args.new_string:
Ask your AI how your week went, and its three lines land here.
**Week of 2 November:** walked six days out of seven and read every evening. Water slipped on two days. Next week: a full bottle on the desk before the first meeting.
